description: This Java source file implements an Android activity named LoaderCustom, demonstrating a custom Loader that asynchronously loads and displays installed applications, with search functionality to filter the list.

classes.name: LoaderCustom
classes.description: Main activity class that hosts the application list fragment.

classes.name: AppEntry
classes.description: Represents a single application entry with its application info, label, icon, and mounted status.

classes.name: InterestingConfigChanges
classes.description: Tracks configuration changes to determine if the app list needs to be rebuilt.

classes.name: PackageIntentReceiver
classes.description: BroadcastReceiver that listens to package installation, removal, and change events to update the loader.

classes.name: AppListLoader
classes.description: Custom AsyncTaskLoader that loads the list of installed applications asynchronously.

classes.name: AppListAdapter
classes.description: ArrayAdapter for displaying application entries in a list, including app icon and label.

classes.name: AppListFragment
classes.description: ListFragment that manages the list display, search filtering, and integrates Loader callbacks.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the fragment manager, and adds the AppListFragment.

methods.name: loadInBackground
methods.description: Retrieves all installed applications, creates AppEntry objects, loads labels, sorts them, and returns the list.

methods.name: deliverResult
methods.description: Delivers the loaded application list to the UI, managing resource cleanup.

methods.name: onStartLoading
methods.description: Starts loading data, reuses existing data if available, or forces a new load if necessary.

methods.name: onStopLoading
methods.description: Attempts to cancel current load tasks.

methods.name: onCanceled
methods.description: Handles load cancellation and resource cleanup.

methods.name: onReset
methods.description: Resets loader state, releases resources, and unregisters receivers.

methods.name: onReleaseResources
methods.description: Placeholder method to release resources associated with the data set.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets new data in the adapter, replacing old data.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Populates list item views with app icon and label.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Initial setup of the fragment, including adapter, loader initialization, and UI preparations.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Creates the options menu, adding a search action item.

methods.name: onQueryTextChange
methods.description: Filters the list based on user input in the search view.

methods.name: onQueryTextSubmit
methods.description: Handles search query submission (no specific action here).

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles clicks on list items, currently logs the clicked item.

methods.name: onCreateLoader
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of AppListLoader.

methods.name: onLoadFinished
methods.description: Updates the adapter with new data and shows the list.

methods.name: onLoaderReset
methods.description: Clears adapter data when loader is reset.
